newsitem.title: UK: New posts at GAM, Kleinwort in London.
newsitem.headline: New posts at GAM, Kleinwort in London.

text.p: Global Asset Management (GAM) has appointed David Duncan as a director with responsibility for European institutional business, while Kleinwort Benson Securities (KBS) has hired a new Latin American banking analyst.

GAM said Duncan joined after experience running his own actuarial consultancy, managing the pension fund of the World Bank, and creating what is now the investment services arm of William M. Mercer in the U.K. He has also been an investment director for Schroder Investment Management.
KBS said Hilario Nuno joins from Standard & Poors in New York where he was a Latin American credit analyst. He has worked for Bear Stearns and Banesto in a similar capacity.
